candidate_replacement.scope: repository and revision name the CPU the candidate is substituted into. The replaceable definition itself lives in the pinned Chisel library recorded under library below, not in the CPU checkout.

library.substitution: Rift2Core resolves Chisel as a compiled Maven artifact, so the candidate class is compiled on its own against the same pinned release and written over the matching entries of a private copy of chisel_2.13-5.1.0.jar. The CPU build reads that copy through an isolated COURSIER_CACHE.

test_programs.policy: Run every program in the fixed required-test catalog that matches the selection patterns.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program completes with zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches and zero observation mismatches. The separate width-16 probe must hold while disabled, reset to seed one, and visit all 65,535 nonzero states before returning to the seed. Its enabled transitions must have Fibonacci shift direction and a fixed linear XOR feedback function.

fixed_test_patches.purpose: Compare the address-translation replacement selector's generated sequence with an independently derived maximal-period reference sequence.
Emit a separate 16-bit instance of the same substituted class used by the cache directory.
